binary: naab-lang: Release, -DNAAB_CONFIG_MUTATION=ON; the other binaries suites call (naab-gov and the helpers) from the ordinary unoptimised build, which has no removal hook
scope: 411 units run-all-tests.sh lists (shell suites and tool self-tests); single .naab files not included

survivor_groups.template-only: loaded only by the whole-template loader: no suite written for it loads it
survivor_groups.at-template-value: every value the probe removed equals the template's value (screened; the template's value is not always the default)
survivor_groups.other-value: some suite sets it to a value other than the template's, and none noticed it removed
